solution.description: COMPLETE LIST (Theorem F of project note). u = v' solves the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky wave equation u''' = 30 u^2 + b0 u'' + c0 u' + d u + f. (1) Always: v = u0 z + l, 30 u0^2 + d u0 + f = 0. (2) If b0^2 + 16 c0 = 0, in addition v = wp(z - z0; g2, g3) + (b0/4) zeta(z - z0; g2, g3) + C z + l, g2 = b0^4/3072, C = -(b0^3 + 64 d)/3840, g3 = (13 b0^6 - 2048 d^2 + 245760 f)/4423680 (card Q42B-BETA0-ZETA). Nothing else: if b0^2 + 16 c0 != 0 there is no Laurent series; if it is zero, the Laurent series of u at a triple pole is unique and is that of the elliptic solution.
